"""Static author metadata only: never import or execute the custody program."""
from pathlib import Path
import ast
import hashlib
import json

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
HARNESS = ROOT / 'harness'
SCRIPT = HARNESS / 'tools/retain_original.py'
BRANCH = 'codex/hia-u32-original-custody-v134-r1-20261114-dda7'


def pin(path):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    return {'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            'git_blob': hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(raw)).encode() + b'\0' + raw).hexdigest(),
            'git_mode': '100644'}


def write_once(path, raw):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if path.exists():
        assert path.read_bytes() == raw
    else:
        path.write_bytes(raw)


def main():
    raw = SCRIPT.read_bytes()
    parsed = ast.parse(raw)
    imports = []
    for node in ast.walk(parsed):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            imports.extend(alias.name for alias in node.names)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
            imports.append(node.module)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.Call):
            if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name):
                assert node.func.id not in ('eval', 'exec', 'compile', '__import__')
            elif isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute):
                assert node.func.attr not in ('system', 'popen', 'execv', 'execve', 'execl', 'execle',
                                              'spawnv', 'spawnve', 'extract', 'extractall')
    assert set(imports) <= {'__future__', 'base64', 'hashlib', 'json', 'os', 'pathlib', 'shutil',
                            'stat', 'sys', 'time', 'traceback', 'urllib.error', 'urllib.parse',
                            'urllib.request', 'zipfile', 'zlib'}
    workflow = '''name: Preserve exact completed u32 original artifact without product execution
on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/hia-u32-original-custody-v134-r1-20261114-dda7]

  contents: read
  actions: read
jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: harness
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Receive and preserve only the fixed completed original artifact
        id: capture
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          CUSTODY_SCRIPT_SHA256: __CUSTODY_SCRIPT_DIGEST_VALUE__
          PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
        run: python3 -I -S -B harness/tools/retain_original.py "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/relay"
      - name: Preserve complete original reports and all custody observations
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: u32-original-reports-43579403463-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: relay/reports
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 6
          retention-days: 90
'''
    placeholder_line = '          CUSTODY_SCRIPT_SHA256: __CUSTODY_SCRIPT_DIGEST_VALUE__\n'
    digest = pin(SCRIPT)['sha256']
    actual_line = '          CUSTODY_SCRIPT_SHA256: ' + digest + '\n'
    assert workflow.count(placeholder_line) == 1
    workflow = workflow.replace(placeholder_line, actual_line, 1)
    assert '__CUSTODY_SCRIPT_DIGEST_VALUE__' not in workflow
    assert workflow.count('        env:\n') == 1
    env_text = workflow.split('        env:\n', 1)[1].split('        run:', 1)[0]
    env_rows = [line[10:].split(': ', 1) for line in env_text.splitlines()]
    assert all(line.startswith('          ') for line in env_text.splitlines())
    assert len(env_rows) == len(dict(env_rows)) == 3
    assert dict(env_rows) == {'GITHUB_TOKEN': '${{ github.token }}',
                             'CUSTODY_SCRIPT_SHA256': digest,
                             'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': "'1'"}
    runtime_reads = [node for node in ast.walk(parsed)
                     if isinstance(node, ast.Call)
                     and ast.dump(node.func) == ast.dump(ast.parse('os.environ.get', mode='eval').body)
                     and node.args and isinstance(node.args[0], ast.Constant)
                     and node.args[0].value == 'CUSTODY_SCRIPT_SHA256']
    assert len(runtime_reads) == 1
    for i in range(10):
        workflow += '''      - name: Preserve original ZIP byte span NUM
        if: ${{ always() && hashFiles('relay/parts/part-NUM.bin') != '' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: u32-original-span-43579403463-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-NUM
          path: relay/parts/part-NUM.bin
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 6
          retention-days: 90
'''.replace('NUM', f'{i:03d}')
    workflow_path = HARNESS / '.github/workflows/custody.yml'
    write_once(workflow_path, workflow.encode())
    files = {str(path.relative_to(HARNESS)): pin(path) for path in (workflow_path, SCRIPT)}
    plan = {

        'transport': {

            'On an earlier validation failure, the unchanged full or partial ZIP is still transported when raw-span creation has not begun. If span creation itself fails, uploaded partial spans and append-only metadata preserve their actual state; no success or automatic retry is synthesized.',

            'parsed': True, 'only_stdlib_imports': True,
